datasets.name: Satellite images
datasets.verbatim: we invited experts to use Google Earth to locate the loess landslides’ longitude and latitude and then used 91 Weitu (image elevation download software: http://www.91weitu.com) to acquire the satellite image with sufficient resolution.

methods.name: Two-phase image-based data-driven framework
methods.summary: A two-phase framework where the first phase uses a pre-trained Faster-RCNN to detect landslide regions and generate bounding boxes, and the second phase uses a modified U-Net with inception blocks and dilation to perform pixel-level segmentation within those bounding boxes.
methods.source: Huajin Li, Yusen He, Qiang Xu, Jiahao Deng, Weile Li, Yong Wei

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the two-phase framework is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
